name: Written Response to Enrollment Complaint
description: Written response to any properly filed enrollment complaint, with a copy sent to PDE's School Services Unit when the complainant also filed with PDE.
recipient: Complainant; PA Department of Education, School Services Unit (copy, if complaint also filed there)
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall provide a written response to any properly filed complaint, along with a copy to the Department of Education, School Services Unit, if the complainant also filed their complaint there.
